steps.name: Prepare ranked gene list from DESeq2 results
steps.question: From de_results.csv (gene, base_mean, log2_fold_change, log2_fold_change SE/stat, p-value, padj columns for the psoriasis-lesional vs control contrast), build a clean ranking metric (e.g., signed -log10(p) * sign(log2FC), or the DESeq2 Wald statistic if present) per gene symbol, deduplicate gene symbols, and drop rows with NA statistics.
acceptance_criteria: Output is a two-column table (gene symbol, rank metric) with no missing or duplicate gene symbols
Number of genes retained and dropped (NA/duplicate) is reported
Distribution of the rank metric is sane (finite, not all zero/tied)

steps.name: Hallmark GSEA (pre-ranked) on treated vs control
steps.context: Use the pre-ranked gene list produced in T1S1 and the MSigDB human hallmark gene sets (h.all.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt, 50 sets, HGNC symbols) staged under /mnt/refs. Run a GSEA-preranked style test (fgsea in R, or gseapy/blitzgsea in Python) with 1000+ permutations, report NES, p-value, and BH-adjusted q-value per hallmark set, and the leading-edge genes for each significant set.
steps.question: Which of the 50 MSigDB hallmark pathways are significantly enriched (up or down) in psoriasis-lesional vs control skin, using the pre-ranked gene list from the DESeq2 contrast?
acceptance_criteria: All 50 hallmark gene sets are tested (or the count actually matched after symbol overlap is reported)
Output table has NES, p-value, FDR q-value, leading-edge gene count per pathway
Pathways with FDR < 0.05 are flagged as significant; direction (up in lesional vs up in control) is explicit from NES sign
If the hallmark gmt file is not found at run time, the step reports this explicitly rather than silently skipping enrichment

steps.name: Hallmark over-representation test on significant DE genes
steps.context: Complements the ranked GSEA (T2S1) with a simpler, threshold-based hypergeometric/Fisher enrichment as a robustness check, run separately for up-regulated and down-regulated DE genes against the human hallmark gene sets. Background gene universe is all 12000 genes tested in de_results.csv.
steps.question: Among genes significantly differentially expressed (padj < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1, using the existing de_results.csv thresholds) between psoriasis-lesional and control skin, which hallmark pathways are over-represented, tested separately for up- and down-regulated gene sets against the same MSigDB human hallmark background?
acceptance_criteria: Up- and down-regulated DE gene lists are enrichment-tested separately against the full 12000-gene background as the universe
Output includes odds ratio/enrichment ratio, p-value, and BH-adjusted q-value per hallmark set for each direction
Result is compared qualitatively against the T2S1 GSEA hits to note overlap/discrepancy in the final table

steps.name: Consolidate hallmark pathway findings
steps.context: Merge T2S1 (GSEA NES/FDR) and T2S2 (ORA odds ratio/FDR) results into one ranked table of hallmark pathways, keeping direction of change (lesional-up vs lesional-down) and flagging pathways significant in both tests as high-confidence versus those significant in only one as lower-confidence.
steps.question: What is the consolidated set of hallmark pathways that change between psoriasis-lesional and control skin, reconciling the pre-ranked GSEA and over-representation results, and what is their direction of change?
acceptance_criteria: Single consolidated table with pathway name, GSEA NES/FDR, ORA odds ratio/FDR (up and down), and a confidence flag (both methods agree vs single method)
Report explicitly lists which hallmark pathways are significantly changed (FDR<0.05 in at least one method) and their direction
No claims of causality or mechanism beyond what the enrichment statistics support

plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control: hallmark pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: DESeq2 results (12000 genes) for psoriasis lesional vs control skin already exist (de_results.csv). The research question is purely about which hallmark pathways change between the two groups, so no re-analysis of counts is needed. The plan runs GSEA-style (fgsea/decoupleR-style ranked) enrichment against the MSigDB human hallmark gene sets (50 sets, HGNC symbols, staged locally) using a rank metric derived from the DESeq2 statistics, then a complementary over-representation test on the significant DE gene subset for robustness, and finally produces a consolidated, interpreted summary of the pathways that move between psoriasis-lesional and control skin.
